gpu: ANGLE (Apple, ANGLE Metal Renderer: Apple M4, Unspecified Version)

method.frameIntervals: R3F useFrame delta, non-overlapping windows of 300 frames after a 16-second probe warmup; hidden-document windows discarded.
method.drawCounts: renderer.info.autoReset=false; reset at priority -2, before the sky and main render. Counts include all rendered passes, not unique scene geometry. Width/height are drawing-buffer dimensions.
method.gpu: Nonblocking EXT_disjoint_timer_query_webgl2 queries surrounding public renderer.render calls; summed by R3F frame. Samples resolve asynchronously and do not measure CPU, browser composition, or presentation latency.
method.scope: One moving camera, random door arrangement, short windows, no production or physical M2 benchmark. Different resolutions were not locked to the same scene view.
method.cleanup: Probe removed from runtime after inspection. Source retained here only as evidence.

samples.note: Initial version of probe; no GPU timing recorded for this sample.

limitations: M4 host results cannot establish M2 iPad Safari or M2 MacBook thermal headroom.
Development tools, probe overhead, OS/browser scheduling, and other host workload can affect results.
No synchronized CPU/GPU trace or long thermal soak was collected.
GPU query windows and frame-interval windows resolve on different schedules; their mean values are not directly subtractable.
Do not interpret 300 frames without a >33.34ms interval as a long-term worst-case guarantee.
